en: A colorized panoramic view across a river toward a dense historic townscape with brick houses, churches, and towers. Smoke from a steam-powered boat or industrial facility drifts along the waterfront. In the foreground there is a riverbank with shrubs and low vegetation. At the top left, red printed text in Dutch reads "Gezicht op Nijmegen." The overall style suggests an early 20th‑century picture postcard.
